name: MedStation
verdict: MedStation spent $142.84 on Meta over 28 days and generated zero tracked leads, triggering a lead drought despite 294 clicks and 89 GBP actions (including 11 calls), suggesting strong ad spend with a broken or missing conversion event. The top concern is a 120.63% spike in 7-day spend driven by the "WARM-RETARGETING" campaign ($59.01), while GBP actions dropped 44.44% in the same window, meaning more money is going out just as organic engagement is falling.

performance.verdict: Zero tracked leads after $142.84 spent; SOW is 45+ days overblocked.

findings.text: Zero leads across all 28 days despite $142.84 Meta spend and 294 clicks — conversion event is absent or broken, making CPL undefined and every dollar unaccountable.
5 of 9 SOW milestones due 2026-07-31 are overdue (stack test, GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta account/CAPI, landing pages/tracking) — 45+ days past deadline, directly causing F1.
3 additional SOW milestones due 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-01 also overdue: Meta reactivation lanes, Search campaigns, LSA verification, and GHL nurture sequences — Phase 1 is not executing.
GBP actions fell from a prior-7d baseline to near-zero last 3 days (0, 0, 0 vs prior 3-day avg of ~1.3); spend spiked 120.63% in same window — organic and paid moving in opposite directions.
GA4 sessions dropped to 71 and 67 on the last 2 days of the series, vs a prior-3-day avg of ~163 — a 3-day declining signal suggesting site or tracking degradation, not ad performance.

suggestions.text: Pause all Meta spend immediately until conversion tracking is confirmed firing — $14.04/day is burning with zero measurable return.
suggestions.monday_update: All Meta spend (currently ~$14.04/day, $142.84 over 28 days) should be paused until the landing page and conversion event confirmed in the SOW milestone are live and verified firing. The due date for landing pages and tracking was 2026-07-31 — 45 days overdue. Success check: at least one test lead recorded in GHL before spend resumes. Target resolution: 2026-09-21.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue July-31 SOW milestones to Nacer and Sohib — unblock stack test and CAPI before any budget is restored.
suggestions.monday_update: Nine SOW milestones across Ops, CRM, Meta, Google, and Web are past due — the oldest by 45 days (2026-07-31). No paid channel can produce accountable results until the end-to-end stack test passes and conversion tracking is live. Nacer (Ops) and Sohib (Account) must confirm a revised completion date for each milestone. Success check: stack test completed and first tracked lead appears in GHL by 2026-09-21.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 sessions: 3-day drop to avg ~69 may signal tracking breakage — confirm before interpreting GBP or paid trends.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions fell to 71 and 67 on the last two days of the series, down from a prior-3-day average of ~163. This may be a tracking issue rather than real traffic loss, especially given the known GA4 double-count caveat. Monitor for 3 more days; if sessions remain below 80, flag for technical audit. Re-check: 2026-09-17.
